$doc: WP4 (order 2026-08-11 §8): phase-1 difficulty x phase-1 learning-rate 2x2 factorial. The prior L1 factorial varied PHASE-2 LR with phase-1 LR fixed at 1e-4, so it cannot say whether phase-1 LR caused the collapse. This design crosses phase-1 dynamics {normal, easy} with phase-1 LR {1e-4, 3e-5}; phase-2 stays at the active D0 range point. Mechanics screen first (one pass-equivalent per cell, collapse/contract screen, not performance); the decision run spends the full document-38 budget only if the screen finds a viable region.
question: Was the apparent easy/normal difficulty question actually a phase-1 learning-rate problem?

nested_split_contract.$doc: Finding 224: the EXECUTING pipeline consumes this typed nested contract directly (nested_split_mode=l1). The role_facts below are ASSERTIONS the runner verifies against the freshly materialized per-role CSVs before any model construction — wrong path, wrong sha, wrong scored/context count, swapped role dates, a missing context declaration, context counted in score, or any sealed_test materialization refuses the cell. Authoritative values reproduced by the independent auditor 2026-08-11.

role_use.train_monitor: in-sample member of the paired comparator (2190 scored rows, 2022)
role_use.inner_validation: selection member of the paired comparator (2190 scored rows, 2023)
role_use.outer_validation: final truth ONLY — one evaluation after selection (2196 scored rows, 2024)
role_use.sealed_test: SEALED — no CSV path, hash, row load or model evaluation may be emitted (2025)

held_fixed.$doc: Order §8: every non-factor identity field is pinned. Replay and optimizer carry are excluded as factors this round — every ladder arm already proved optimizer_state_transferred=false and replay_size_at_boundary=0 at the boundary (audit §3).
held_fixed.handoff_viability_evidence: required on every phase-1 checkpoint (WP3 / finding 221 block)
held_fixed.topology_features_costs_protection: L1 v3 frozen system manifest contract (sha 00bfa585 family) — spread 1e-4, protected entries required, min_equity 100, financing declared-disabled
held_fixed.dates: ladder/L1 nested split contract; sealed 2025 inaccessible
held_fixed.selection: normal-realistic paired comparator on train-monitor + inner validation; outer validation truth
held_fixed.anchor_rule: every cell starts from the exact per-seed anchor, never a preceding cell's terminal

assignments.$doc: One seed per physical GPU; ALL FOUR cells of a seed run sequentially on that same GPU so hardware is paired within seed. Distributed anchors hash-verified on their hosts 2026-08-11.

cell_order.$doc: Deterministic cyclic Latin square: every cell occupies every within-seed position exactly once across seeds — no order/thermal confounding.

mechanics_screen.budget: one pass-equivalent per cell (1 phase-1 epoch + 1 phase-2 epoch at 20000 timesteps, matching the ladder pass budget)

budget_knobs.$doc: Executable form of the budget line above (runner WP4; the prose stays authoritative for intent). The runner refuses any values other than one pass-equivalent, and refuses an epoch_timesteps that does not match the ladder pass budget.

requires: 16/16 records with exact identities and terminal artifacts (terminal_model_path + terminal_model_sha256 mandatory — finding 223 contract)

a typed 16-entry replica proof file (tools/p1lr_collect.py, agent_multi.p1lr_replica_proof.v1) proving every terminal loads on the replica host, bound to (experiment_identity, contract_sha256, seed, cell, terminal_relative_path, terminal_model_sha256, loads=true) — the verdict REFUSES without it (finding 225)
direct handoff-viability facts on every phase-1 checkpoint (finding 221 block)
at least one trained arm not CONSTANT_POLICY and not BELOW_NORMAL_THRESHOLD before the decision budget is spent
mechanics_screen.collapse_outcome: PHASE1_LR_REGION_COLLAPSED — stop, do not burn the full run

decision_run.$doc: Only if the screen finds a viable region AND the 16-terminal replica proof passes (finding 225 gate). Document-38 real L1 stopping. Executable form (finding 226): distinct content-addressed identity (profile p1lr_decision_run) and distinct output root; every decision cell starts from the ORIGINAL per-seed anchor, never a screen terminal.

budget_knobs.$doc: 4 phase-1 epochs + 1996 phase-2 max epochs = the 2000 pass-equivalent per-cell ceiling below, at the ladder pass budget.

decision_run.truth: one final outer-validation evaluation after selection; sealed 2025 inaccessible

forbidden: broad LR sweep (LR_easy x LR_normal response surface requires a viable easy arm from THIS factorial first)
reusing any L1 decision or ladder identity
citing the ladder as a pure boundary effect — accepted wording is the v3-vs-v4 checkpoint-selection/handoff bundle with easy-phase action-amplitude collapse exposed by the normal deadband

execution_semantics.$doc: Corrections 231/232 are EXECUTABLE semantics, not documentation. They change what the selector measures and what a dead cell publishes, so they belong in the content-addressed identity: any run materialized before them is diagnostic only and can never be aggregated with a run materialized after them.
execution_semantics.causal_context_enforcement_note: role and context_rows resolve from the VERIFIED nested manifest; ContextPrefixWrapper wraps every baseline and per-epoch train_monitor/inner_validation rollout BEFORE _rollout; prefix rows force hold and are excluded from reward, action statistics, canonical traces, trades, weekly metrics and horizons; every arm reaches the score boundary at equal opening equity (finding 231)
execution_semantics.inactive_cell_semantics_note: an inactive cell publishes one immutable non-promotable record with terminal custody and a load proof, receives one diagnostic-only final outer evaluation that can never be relabeled best_checkpoint, and the seed runner continues to its remaining cells (finding 232)
execution_semantics.superseded_reason: materialized under the pre-231/232 semantics; preserved as diagnostic evidence, never aggregated, never a warm start, never a DOIN gene, never champion succession, never published

activity_classifications.$doc: Finding 232: activity classification is reported ALONGSIDE the document-38 outcome, never inside its pinned enum. Partial survival types the picture; the document-38 outcome for a partially collapsed factorial is INCONCLUSIVE with the dead cells named.
